issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other - Water Fund 47,437.00, Sewer Fund 46,117.00
issues.issue: This is the only receipt line of the Water fund and nearly all of the Sewer fund's receipts. It is almost certainly water/sewer charges (charges for services/fees), but the page doesn't say so. Keeping it in other with review is defensible.

issues.on_page: Line 2 Investments 114,284.15 (General 103,972.81 + MFO 10,311.34); line 27 Investments 167,148.54 (General 156,373.42 + MFO 10,775.12)
issues.issue: Investments are printed separately, but beginning_investments and ending_investments were left null (the amounts are inside beginning_cash/ending_cash). The rule says to fill these fields when investments are reported separately, as informational values. This is the extractor's assumption, explained in notes.
